messages:
maria: Quick sync: I'm iterating on an export flow for audit trails. Two UXs: inline compact preview vs downloadable full ledger. Thinking default preview + explicit full download. Opinions?
aj: Prefer explicit full download. Also must enforce consumption-side quotas even for presigned links. Otherwise leaks bypass billing.
sylvia: Compliance checklist: record generator identity, consumer identity (if any), IP, UA, redaction_profile_id, and whether result was preview vs full. Retention configurable per-tenant.
ethan: Performance note: preview generation should be cheap (top-100 changes) and cached for 1h. Full dumps go to object store (S3 or local adapter). Attach manifest with checksums.
maria: Good. API sketch: POST /v1/audit/exports -> returns export_id + preview_url + signed_full_url (if immediate). Prefer generating full URLs lazily to allow revocation.
naveen: Revocation: add /v1/audit/exports/:id/revoke and a revocation list that the presign validator checks. Also support legal-hold webhook to auto-revoke ranges.
product-ux: Console: show "Preview (redacted)" button and a small "Full export" button with cost estimate. Inline preview should show sample rows and a note: "PII masked per redaction profile X".
aj: Cost estimate: run a fast preflight that samples match count -> estimated bytes. Cache results for 10m. Emit telemetry event preflight.
sylvia: Redaction determinism is important for eDiscovery. Ensure redaction maps are stable and include profile id in the export event so downstream tools can reproduce.
ethan: Telemetry events we need: export.requested, export.preview_served, export.full_served, export.revoked, export.presign_failed. Keep event shape flat for NDJSON exports.
maria: Rollout plan: canary w/ export.debug that includes sampled raw actor metadata for debugging, stripped later. Gate with feature flag.
aj: Security: rotate signing keys and add replay protection (nonce + short TTL). Also check tenant-level flags to disable previews for regulated tenants.
ethan: Ops: reconcile object-store access logs with our exported audit events nightly to verify no silent downloads. Add a small job that cross-checks counts and reports diffs.
naveen: Private deployments: provide a local blob adapter implementing same signing+revocation checks. Document config knobs.
product-ux: UX followup: modal asking for a reason (free text) when generating full exports. Include the note in the audit event.
sylvia: Compliance sign-off conditions: revocation API, configurable retention, deterministic redaction, and immutable access logs for generation + consumption.
maria: Thanks — I'll write up a short RFC with proto shapes and link it here. will also include sample NDJSON event schema.
deploy-bot: deploy started: services/audit-export v2.1.0 -> canary on eng-infra (sha: ab12fed)
